articles.title: Foundry Row Gets $48,000 for Sidewalk Ramp
articles.deck: Residents of Foundry Row filled the hall on Tuesday to ask questions about the plan.
body: Dana Prentice, who has lived in Foundry Row for 19 years, said the response has been better than anyone expected. The group has raised $48,000 so far and is asking for help with supplies and food.
Public works estimates the work will take about 19 weeks once it begins. Organizers say the project is on schedule and that volunteers are still needed on Tuesday mornings.
The plan calls for sidewalk ramp along Wren Street, with work expected to start in December. The Foundry Row Improvement Group will post updates on its bulletin board outside the library.

articles.title: Sergio Iwasaki, 83, Tailor
articles.deck: Friends remember Sergio Iwasaki for the many years of service to Bellwood.
body: Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Bellwood. Sergio Iwasaki died in April at home on Kiln Road, at the age of 83.

Born in Bellwood in the years after the war, Sergio Iwasaki spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood. Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Foxglove Heights Neighbors in his or her name.

articles.title: Letter: Support the Basketball Court
body: To the editor: I have lived on Walnut Road for 8 years, and I want to say what a difference the Mill Hill Lions Club has made.
Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.
I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the April meeting. Please keep the basketball court in the budget. Many of us on Walnut Road use it every week.
Patrice Gruber, Marsh Landing
